findings.evidence: Chain comparison: `:735-740` vs `:878-885` differ only by `Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.sumComm (Fin q) (Fin (p+1))) (Equiv.refl _)`; `:751-766` vs `:896-911` are the same three lemmas with the same one-line `simp [_, splitLastEquiv]` proof; `:768-797` vs `:913-941` are the same two weight lemmas; `:812-839` vs `:962-987` are the same `map_app'` calc. Type check of the proposed composition: `-(F (p+1) q) ≃ᵢ F q (p+1)`, so `(-(F (p+1) q)).prod sq ≃ᵢ (F q (p+1)).prod sq ≃ᵢ F (q+1) (p+1)`.
findings.fix: Delete `signatureSwitchStandardIndexEquiv`, `signatureSwitchStandardLinearEquiv` and their five helper lemmas. Add one small isometry `realCliffordFormNegIsometry (p q) : (-(realCliffordForm p q)).IsometryEquiv (realCliffordForm q p)` built from `finAddFlip` (`Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Fin/Basic.lean:309`, coordinate equations `finAddFlip_apply_castAdd` :313 and `finAddFlip_apply_natAdd` :317 give the two weight cases directly), then define `realCliffordSignSwitchStandardIsometry p q := (QuadraticMap.IsometryEquiv.prod (realCliffordFormNegIsometry (p+1) q) (.refl _)).trans (splitLastPositive q (p+1)).symm`, using `QuadraticMap.IsometryEquiv.prod` (`Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/Prod.lean:61`) and `IsometryEquiv.trans/symm/refl` (`IsometryEquiv.lean:78,83,89`). The three `@[simp]` generator equations (:990, :1007, :1022) then follow from the component lemmas.
findings.issue: `signatureSwitchStandardIndexEquiv`/`signatureSwitchStandardLinearEquiv` and their five private lemmas (:877–960) re-derive the `signatureSwitchSplit*` block (:733–809) added a few lines above: identical `finSumFinEquiv.symm ▸ sumCongr (splitLastEquiv _) ▸ sumAssoc ▸ sumComm ▸ sumAssoc.symm ▸ sumCongr finSumFinEquiv` chain, identical `_symm_inl_pos/_symm_inl_neg/_symm_inr` lemmas proved by `simp [_, splitLastEquiv]`, identical `realCliffordWeight_of_lt/of_le` weight lemmas, and the same `Fintype.sum_sum_type`/`Fintype.sum_equiv` calc in `map_app'`. The only mathematical difference is one extra `Equiv.sumComm (Fin q) (Fin (p+1))`, i.e. a block swap.

findings.evidence: `:733-734` `signatureSwitchSplitIndexEquiv (p q) : Fin ((p + 1 + 1) + q) ≃ Fin ((p + 1) + q) ⊕ Fin 1` — every `p + 1` is opaque in the proofs at `:751-809` and in the `map_app'` calc at `:816-839`; grep shows the only consumer is `realCliffordSignatureSwitchRecurrenceEquiv` at `:1043`.
findings.fix: State it generally as `realCliffordSplitLastPositiveIsometry (p q : ℕ) : (realCliffordForm (p + 1) q).IsometryEquiv ((realCliffordForm p q).prod (QuadraticMap.sq (R := ℝ) (A := ℝ)))` (same proof script, `p + 1 ↦ p`) and set `realCliffordPositiveSplitIsometry p q := realCliffordSplitLastPositiveIsometry (p + 1) q`, or use the general form directly at `(p+1, q)` in `realCliffordSignatureSwitchRecurrenceEquiv` (:1038). The same declaration then supplies the `(q, p+1)` instance needed by the previous finding.
findings.issue: `realCliffordPositiveSplitIsometry` and its whole private block are stated only at `p + 1 + 1`, an unnecessary specialization: no step uses `p ≥ 1` (`:776` `i.castSucc.isLt`, `:779` `simpa using i.isLt`, `:782-786` `simp`, `:797` `realCliffordWeight_of_lt (by simp)` all go through verbatim with `p+1` replaced by `p`). Because it is specialized, it cannot serve as the shared construction for the standard isometry above, forcing the clone, and it repeats the pattern of the pre-existing `realBott*` block (:433-580).

summary: The two new coordinate-isometry blocks are near-clones of each other (and of the existing `realBott*` block): `realCliffordSignSwitchStandardIsometry` is just a block swap composed with the split isometry the PR already builds, and `realCliffordPositiveSplitIsometry` is an artificially specialized instance of a general split lemma its own proof establishes. Factor both through one general split isometry plus a `finAddFlip`-based negation isometry.
